reader.requirement: At --std 85 a comma or semicolon immediately followed by a space must be accepted as the separator space anywhere a space separator may stand (between clauses, operands, statement words, phrases, inside subscript, reference-modification and argument lists, in COPY and REPLACE text), while a comma inside a PICTURE character-string stays a PICTURE symbol, and a comma or semicolon with no following space is no separator.

reader.notes: One lexer rule (FNARG_SEPARATOR) matches ', '/'; ' everywhere and skips it like a space outside list regions; inside a list region ListItemBoundary keeps it only where a space would separate two items. SeparatorRule reports a comma or semicolon with no following space (COBOL2631). The PICTURE lexer mode keeps an embedded comma in the character-string and ends the string at ', '. Nothing on the path reads the edition.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-230/r2d.cob at --std 85: '01 B PICTURE; 9(3) VALUE 12.' -> 'error COBOL0001: missing token before 9' and 'unexpected ('. r2e.cob: '01 B PIC, 999 VALUE 12.' -> 'error COBOL2419: the PICTURE character-string , ends in the symbol ...' plus COBOL0307. r2c.cob: 'PICTURE IS, X(2)' also refused (COBOL0001 at '('). Same refusals at --std 2023 (r2d-002, r2e-002). The format is 'PICTURE IS character-string' with a separator space between the key word and the character-string; SR2 lets ', ' or '; ' stand anywhere the separator space is used, and SR9's paragraph says 'PICTURE character-strings are delimited only by the separators space, comma, semicolon, or period'. A semicolon is never a PICTURE symbol, so the 'Except when the comma is used in a PICTURE character-string' clause cannot reach '; '; and ',' alone is no allowable character-string (VI.5.9.3 SR2), so the leading comma is the separator too. Cause in the lexer: CobolLexer.g4 mode PICMODE skips only [ \n]+ (PIC_WS) before the string, so PIC_STRING captures the leading ',' or ';' (its trailing-separator trim fires only when Text.Length > 1 and only at the END). Everything else the reader did not try passes: r2b.cob 'IDENTIFICATION, DIVISION.', 'DATA, DIVISION.', 'SELECT, F1, ASSIGN, TO, ...; ORGANIZATION, IS,' across a line, 'FD, F1; LABEL RECORDS, ARE,', '01, X PIC X(6), VALUE, "A, B;C"' (literal content kept), '88, N-ODD, VALUE, 1, 3; 5 THRU, 9', 'PIC 9,999, .', 'MOVE 1234 TO Y, .', 'GO, TO, P2, P3, DEPENDING, ON, N' (-> P3), 'P0, SECTION.', a comma in column 72 before a continued line, 'STOP, RUN.' all run correctly (X=A, B;C Y=1,234 / EVEN / P3 / COL72 END). kb/Work searched (PIC, / PICTURE; / PICMODE leading separator): no note; PB5213 (multiple IS) is a different defect. cite.py: OK  §1985:IV.4.2.1 SR2  (4.2.1 Separators)  the text is in SR2; OK  §1985:IV.4.2.1 SR9  (4.2.1 Separators) ('PICTURE character-strings are delimited only by the separators space, comma, semicolon, or period'); OK  §1985:VI.5.9.3 SR2  (5.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2.
